# Feature: Skill Progression v2 — Character Editor UX (3/3)

## Intent

Issue #91: Wire Character Editor to #90 domain contracts — three start sources (7/2/1), stackable background points, applied EB, full check formulas, level 3–19 progression slots. UI consumes rules kernel only; no duplicated caps/EB/advance logic in React.

## Preconditions

- #94 architecture merged; #90 skill-progression domain on `main`.
- Editor loads/saves via owner-scoped character service and SagaDrive profile JSONB.

## Happy Path

- [ ] Background panel allocates 2 stackable framework points (+2 or +1/+1); graph shows only occupied nodes after completion.
- [ ] Skills panel shows three primary source counters (7 free / 2 background / 1 archetype); no blocking min-6 trained rule.
- [ ] Skill detail shows provenance, global vs applied EB, and full d20 formula from domain APIs.
- [ ] Level > 1 shows unlocked slots 3/5/7/… with rank-up, learn, or specialization choices domain-validated.
- [ ] Save persists `freeSkillRanks`, `backgroundSkillPoints`, `skillAdvances`, `specializations`, `skillProvenanceStatus: complete`; reload roundtrip matches.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Background pool change resets invalid points/specialization with clear UI feedback.
- [ ] Startcap 3 blocks add with explanation; fewer than six trained skills allowed.
- [ ] Legacy profile without provenance shows unresolved state, not invented sources.
- [ ] Level 17 rank 0/1 applied EB 0/2 in formula panel.
- [ ] Keyboard-accessible +/- controls for background allocator and free ranks.

## Regression

- [ ] Character editor regression check updated for v2 UX contracts.
- [ ] Architecture boundary check passes.
- [ ] `npm run test-gate` green.

## Security Coverage

- F-03: Skill/specialization names rendered as text (existing Input); no new HTML injection paths.
- B-01/B-04: Save still via repository assert from #90; client validation is UX-only.
- No new Supabase/service-role client usage.

## Assumptions

- Level-down does not auto-delete future slot data in this slice; slots above current level hidden but preserved in state until explicit edit (matches #90 persistence).

## Implementation Notes

- **Acceptance:** `.qa/acceptance/skill-progression-v2-character-editor-ux.md`
- **Background:** `CharacterBackgroundPanel` + `BackgroundSkillPointsAllocator` — 2 stackable framework points; graph collapses to occupied nodes after allocation.
- **Skills:** `CharacterSkillsPanel` — 7/2/1 counters, `SkillCheckFormulaPanel` (provenance, global/applied EB, d20 formula), `SkillProgressionSlotsPanel` (levels 3–19).
- **Editor state/save:** `backgroundSkillPoints`, `skillAdvances`, `specializations`, `skillProvenanceStatus: 'complete'`; ranks via `resolveSagaDriveSkillRanks`; legacy bootstrap via `resolveSagaDriveSkillBuildState`.
- **Removed:** min-6 trained skills gate; legacy 2-toggle background training UX.
- **Regression:** `character-editor-regression-check.mjs`, `background-framework-regression-check.mjs` updated for v2 contracts.
- **Validation:** `npm run test-gate` green (uncommitted working tree).
